title: MR9A breadcrumbs: all DIMMs removed (POST 53), no failed record
configuration: MACHINIST E5-MR9A PRO V1.2 (Q87), four 16 GB DDR4 DIMMs (64 GB)
observations: All four DIMMs removed: POST 53. User reports no CMOS clear and no battery removal.
After restoring RAM, E0-E9 were identical to the first boot: A1, slot 0 BF000000, slot 1 all FF, counter zero. No failed checkpoint was retained.
limits: Negative result for capture of the no-RAM attempt; failed-pass freezing and retention are not validated. With no CMOS snapshot from the halted attempt, a bypassed hook, inaccessible storage at that phase, or a later overwrite cannot be told apart. Root cause unresolved; does not reproduce the intermittent b0/b7 fault.
